title: Senior Software Engineer Interview Curriculum: System Design and Java Backend
summary: A balanced study curriculum tailored for a Java & Spring Boot engineer targeting senior software engineering roles. Covers JVM internals, storage engines, distributed primitives, caching, messaging, and system design interviews.
description: A comprehensive study curriculum tailored for engineers targeting senior software engineering roles at tier-1 and FAANG technology companies. Focuses on deep Java/JVM internals, storage engine mechanics, distributed systems primitives, scalable architecture building blocks, real-world case studies (flash sales, feed generation, collaborative editing), and the 45-minute system design interview communication framework.
